Container.Name: Syncalist
Container.Overview: Keeps Plex Home music playlists in sync between users. The Plex Home admin chooses which playlists are shared and with whom, then any member can edit their copy and the changes reach everyone. Sign in with the Plex account that owns the server.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Syncalist web interface.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database and encryption key. Back up both files together.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Address of your Plex server, e.g. http://192.168.1.36:32400. Only pre-fills first-time setup; it can be changed in the web UI.

Config.Name: Sync interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Initial sync interval. It can be changed later in the web UI.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (100 = users on Unraid).
